action: Switch to the Rigging workspace.
Select Rigging from the Shelf.
Open the Quick Rig tool.
Click the plus button in the Quick Rig tool.
Enter a name for the character.
Select the Step-by-Step option.
notes: The alternative is One-Click.

action: Select the character geometry.
Click the plus button under Geometry.
notes: Adds the selected geometry.

action: Create or update the guides.
notes: Generates the rigging guides.

action: Switch to the front view.
notes: Allows the guides to be positioned from the front.

action: Adjust the positions of the generated guides.
Expand the guides in the Outliner to identify individual guides.
notes: Allows individual guides to be selected.

action: Select the neck guide and move it to the desired neck position.
notes: Adjusts the neck joint location.

action: Select the head guide and move it toward the top of the character's head.
Select the arm guide and move it into the correct position.
notes: The instructor adjusts an arm that is positioned too far inward.

action: Move the shoulder guide to the correct position.
Select the left shoulder and left arm guides.
notes: Only one side needs adjustment for a symmetrical character.

action: Use the guide adjustment button to mirror the selected guides to the opposite side.
notes: The button transfers guide positions between the left and right sides.

action: Continue adjusting the remaining guides to match the character's anatomy.
Select the left upper-leg guide and move it into the correct position.
Mirror the upper-leg guide adjustment to the opposite side.
Check and adjust the remaining guides to ensure they are correctly positioned.
notes: Final guide-positioning check.

action: Click Create/Update Rig under Skeleton and Rig Generation.
keys_or_menu: Skeleton and Rig Generation > Create/Update Rig
notes: Generates the character skeleton and rig.

action: Inspect the generated rig and its joint structure.
notes: Check whether the joints are positioned correctly.

action: Generate or update the rig after confirming the joint structure.
notes: The instructor repeats the rig-generation step.

action: Select the default binding settings.
notes: Alternative: Current Settings.

action: Select Current Settings to customize the binding configuration.
notes: Alternative to using default settings.

action: Adjust the skinning and binding settings.
Select Skin Cluster as the binding method.
notes: Choose this if you intend to use weight painting later. Proximity Wrap is the alternative.

action: Apply the selected skinning settings.
notes: Binds the character to the generated rig.

action: Move the character to test the rig's deformation.
Open Weight Painting to correct unsatisfactory skin deformation.
notes: Alternative correction method.

action: Return to the default binding settings and initiate another rig update.
notes: Alternative if the current binding does not produce satisfactory results.

action: Confirm deletion of the existing skin when prompted.
notes: Required when replacing the existing skin.

action: Inspect the updated character deformation.
Evaluate the skinning and weight distribution.
notes: Checks how well the automatic weights work.

action: Reopen weight painting and adjust the weights if necessary.
